'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[List of high-altitude object events in 2023|High-altitude object events in 2023]]
**[[2023 Yukon high-altitude object]]
***[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] orders the takedown of an [[unidentified flying object]] over [[Yukon]], which is later shot down by a [[United States Air Force]] [[Lockheed Martin F-22 Raptor|F-22 Raptor]] using a [[AIM-9X Sidewinder]]. The [[Canadian Armed Forces]] have been deployed to collect and analyze the object. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/02/11/politics/norad-additional-object-northern-canada/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**A [[Suicide attack|suicide bomber]] blows himself up near a security forces' vehicle in [[North Waziristan District]], [[Pakistan]], killing three soldiers and wounding 20 more. [https://www.newsdrum.in/international/three-killed-20-injured-in-suicide-attack-in-pak-police (News Drum)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**At least ten [[civilian]]s and a [[Syrian Armed Forces|soldier]] are killed in a [[mass shooting]] by [[Islamic State]] gunmen at a [[truffle]] farm in [[Palmyra]], [[Homs Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/monitor-is-attack-in-central-syria-kills-11-mostly-civilians/6959429.html (AFP via VOA)]
*[[Internal conflict in Peru]] 
**Seven [[Law enforcement in Peru|police officers]] are killed and another is injured when their vehicle is [[ambush]]ed in [[Valle de los Ríos Apurímac, Ene y Mantaro]], [[Peru]], in a suspected attack by remnants of [[Shining Path]]. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Camp Evangelista shooting]]
**Four [[Philippine Army|soldiers]] are killed and another is critically injured by a fellow soldier during a [[mass shooting]] at a [[barracks]] in [[Cagayan de Oro]], [[Northern Mindanao]], [[Philippines]]. The perpetrator is shot dead. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/mindanao/5-dead-in-cagayan-de-oro-army-camp-attack/ (Rappler)]
*[[Murder of Brianna Ghey]]
**A 16-year-old [[Great Britain|British]] [[transgender]] girl, is murdered in a [[premeditated]] attack by Scarlett Jenkinson and Eddie Ratcliffe. After being lured into [[Culcheth Linear Park]] by Jenkinson, Ghey is fatally stabbed. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2024/feb/02/scarlett-jenkinson-eddie-ratcliffe-teenagers-planned-murder-of-brianna-ghey (The Guardian)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 FIFA Club World Cup]]
**In [[association football]], Spanish club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] wins a [[FIFA Club World Cup records and statistics|record]] fifth [[FIFA Club World Cup]] title and eighth [[List of world champion football clubs|club world championship]] after defeating Saudi Arabian club [[Al Hilal SFC|Al Hilal]] 5–3 in the [[2022 FIFA Club World Cup final]] at the [[Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium]] in [[Rabat]], [[Morocco]]. With eight goals, the match was the highest scoring final in Club World Cup history. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2023/feb/11/vinicius-junior-and-valverde-fire-real-madrid-to-club-world-cup-glory (Reuters via ''The Guardian'')]
